summary: The audit checks the required courses and four more graduate courses (one literature-based biological science course, one quantitative physical science course and two more), each letter graded with a B or better except BIOPHYS 250 and MED 255, which are offered only S/NC. The course lists are not complete, so another eligible course is moved in by hand. The 3.0 GPA, the qualifying exam, the advisor match, candidacy, the oral exam and the dissertation are checked by hand; teaching is not required.
